blocks.text: 《使用上の注意》

●本商品は精密に作られています。無理な力を加えたり、落としたりすると破損する恐れがあります。 本商品は精密な電子部品で構成
されています。落としたり、水に濡らしたり、汚したり、分解したりしないでください。 また、高温・低温になるところでの使用、保管は避けて
ください。●プラスチック梱包材は、 開封後はすぐに捨ててください。 ●本商品には塗装部分がありますので、 保管の際には他のもの
(樹脂製品や家具、ソファー)と接触しないようにしてください。 色が移る場合があります。●可動部分・取付部分を無理な方向に強く

ご了承ください。●オージャカリバー -MEMORIAL EDITION -には、対応しているMEMOREALIZE DATA CARD以外をセット
しないでください。故障や破損の原因となります。
blocks.translation:
• This product is made with precise components. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains delicate electronic parts. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it where it will become very hot or very cold.
• Discard plastic packaging materials immediately after opening.
• This product has painted surfaces. When storing it, keep it from contacting other items (plastic products, furniture, sofas), as color transfer may occur.
• Do not strongly pull or bend movable or attached parts in unnatural directions.
• Some spoken lines have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics.
• For Oja Caliber -MEMORIAL EDITION-, do not insert any MEMOREALIZE DATA CARD other than the supported cards. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.

blocks.translation:
△ Caution: To customers — Please read carefully.
● This product is intended for Ages 15+. Do not give it to children younger than the specified age. ● Be sure to read the WEB Instruction Manual. ● This product contains small parts. Take care to prevent small children from accidentally swallowing them, as there is a risk of choking. ● There are pointed and sharp parts; handle and store with care to avoid unexpected injury. ● Do not use near your ears; improper use may damage hearing. ● This product contains electronic components; users with pacemakers should exercise caution. Be careful not to get fingers, hair, or clothing caught in rotating parts. ● Do not put fingers or other objects into gaps of moving parts, as they may become caught and cause injury. ● Do not stare at flashing LED lights for long periods; this may cause discomfort.
《Improper battery use may cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following:》
● Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries. Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries. ● Insert batteries with the + (plus) and - (minus) terminals correctly. ● After use, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage. Do not short-circuit, recharge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire. ● If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If it gets on skin or clothing, wash with water. ● When disposing of batteries or the product, follow your local municipality's waste disposal instructions.

source_blocks.text: 降臨せよ!レジェンドキングオージャー!
さぁ、奇跡を起こしてやろうじゃないか!
source_blocks.translation: Now, let's make a miracle happen!

セリフ
順番
モード切替音 キングオージャー!
宇宙の片隅の惑星 チキュー。6つの王国が治めるこの星に巨大な危機が迫っている。
source_blocks.translation: Chikyu—a planet in a corner of the universe. A massive crisis is looming over this world, which is ruled by six kingdoms.

source_blocks.text: これは平和を守る王たちの物語。 そして、 反逆の戦士たちの物語である。
source_blocks.translation: This is the story of kings who protect the peace. And it is the story of rebel warriors.

source_blocks.text: 我々は新たに世界を脅かす敵が到来した時に備え
source_blocks.translation: We are preparing for the arrival of a new enemy that threatens the world.

source_blocks.text: 国境を超え、利害を排除し、国同士が一丸となって、敵を打ち倒すため新たな組織を結成した。
source_blocks.translation: Transcending national borders and setting aside conflicting interests, nations united to form a new organization for the purpose of defeating the enemy.

source_blocks.text: 五王国、異様事案対策用戦略救命部隊。
source_blocks.translation: Five Kingdoms Strategic Life-Saving Unit for Anomalous Incidents.

source_blocks.text: 通称は、守護神の名に由来し･･･。 王様戦隊キングオージャーとする。
source_blocks.translation: Its common name is derived from that of the guardian deity... and is designated as Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger.

source_blocks.text: 降臨せよ!エクストリームキングオージャー!
俺は媚びねぇ、へつらわねぇ。誰が相手になろうとも、意地とドタマでブッチギる。
source_blocks.translation: I don't pander, and I don't grovel. No matter who stands in my way, I'll leave them in the dust—driven by sheer grit and my own headstrong will.

source_blocks.text: それが、ンコンパ総長、ヤンマ・ガストだ。
source_blocks.translation: That is Nkompa President Yamma Gast.

source_blocks.text: 我が名はイシャバーナの女王ヒメノ・ラン。
source_blocks.translation: My name is Himeno Ran, Queen of Ishabana.

source_blocks.text: ただ我がままに我が道をゆく!散ることを知らぬ花･･･。 その気高きを知るがよい!
source_blocks.translation: I walk my own path, true only to myself! A flower that knows not how to wither... Behold its noble majesty!

source_blocks.text: 民とは命なり。民のためには、 泥に塗れて手を汚す。
source_blocks.translation: The people are life itself. For their sake, I will soil my hands and be covered in mud.

source_blocks.text: それが豊穣の大殿様 カグラギ・ディボウスキ。
source_blocks.translation: That is the Great Lord of Abundance, Kaguragi Dybowski.

source_blocks.text: 法とは王を穿つ矛。 法とは民を守る盾。 なればこそ、ゴッカンは不動なり。
source_blocks.translation: The law is a spear that pierces the king. The law is a shield that protects the people. That is precisely why Gokkan stands immovable.

source_blocks.text: 地が裂け天が降ろうともこのリタ・カニスカは揺るがない!
source_blocks.translation: Even if the earth splits and the heavens fall, I, Rita Kaniska, shall not waver!

source_blocks.text: 俺は、ジェラミー・イドモナラク・ネ・ブラシエリ。
source_blocks.translation: I am Jeramie Idmonarak ne Brasieri.

source_blocks.text: 人、バグナラク、全てを統べて、世界の運命を定める狭間の王様、
source_blocks.translation: The King of the In-Between who rules over all—humans and Bugnarak alike—and determines the fate of the world,

source_blocks.text: その有様を、永久に語り継ぐといい!
source_blocks.translation: See to it that the tale of that spectacle is passed down forever!

source_blocks.text: 恐怖しろ! そしておののけ! 一切の情け容赦なく一木一草ことごとく!
source_blocks.translation: Tremble in fear! Quake! Without a shred of mercy—leaving not a single tree or blade of grass standing!

source_blocks.text: 貴様を討ち滅ぼす者の名はギラ・ハスティー! そして
source_blocks.translation: The name of the one who will destroy you is Gira Husty! And...

source_blocks.text: 王様戦隊キングオージャー!
俺様たちが世界を支配する!
source_blocks.translation: We're going to rule the world!
